test_title: PYST 72: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
A sentence is provided in indirect speech. From the four given options, choose the one that most accurately conveys the sentence in its corresponding direct speech.

​The advisor said that if need be, he would intervene personally.

options.text: "If need be, I will intervene personally," said the advisor.
"If needs be, I shall personally intervene," said the advisor.
"If needed, I might intervene," said the advisor.
If there is need, I would Intervene personally", said the advisor.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indirect Speech:** The advisor said that if need be, he would intervene personally.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"if need be" remains "If need be"**
 
 
• "If need be" is a fixed subjunctive idiom meaning "if it is necessary." It usually remains unchanged when moving bet
